description: This file contains cost calculation utilities for a large language model (LLM) SDK, including functions for computing token-based costs, response costs, image generation costs, and handling various provider-specific pricing schemes. It also manages cost breakdown logging and supports different call types like transcription, search, rerank, and vector store search.
